participants.name: Sakura

persona.name: Sakura
persona.personality: Sakura is a cheerful girl with a slightly mischievous personality. She is very curious and actively takes on new challenges with enthusiasm. She is good at making people laugh with her pranks and solving little mysteries. She is friendly and gets along well with everyone, so she is good at making friends with those around her. However, she also has a slightly clumsy side, but she has a positive personality that allows her to overcome failures with a smile.

participants.private_seed: Every cycle the headline award looks the same size, yet what it actually buys keeps shrinking in some places and holding steady in others. Before ranking anything, I want to know which kinds of spending the agency still absorbs centrally and which now land on the awardee.

participants.name: Takumi

persona.name: Takumi
persona.personality: Takumi is brave and never gives up, even in difficult situations. He may sometimes appear aggressive and rebellious, but in reality, he is deeply protective of those around him and is willing to do his utmost for his friends. He is always calm and thinks carefully about how to solve the problems at hand, but his personality sometimes causes him to act recklessly. He is a little stubborn and finds it difficult to accept advice from others, but as he matures, he will become more flexible.

participants.private_seed: Too many recent awards lost time to things that had nothing to do with the science itself, and the panel usually hears about it only after the money is committed. It seemed worth asking in advance where work in this field actually gets interrupted.

participants.name: Daisuke

persona.name: Daisuke
persona.personality: Daisuke is very introverted and cautious, and tends to be somewhat passive when interacting with others. He finds it difficult to express his feelings and thoughts to others, and often struggles with his emotions internally. He is kind and very compassionate when it comes to helping others, but at times he lacks confidence in himself and struggles with inner conflict. He has a quiet personality, and occasionally his emotions become overwhelming, leading to periods of low mood. However, as he becomes able to rely on those around him, he gradually regains his composure.

participants.private_seed: Our judgements about promise have not aged well, and some of us have watched confident picks quietly stall while plainer ones kept earning their keep. Rather than trust that instinct once more, I went back through what finished awards here actually delivered and when.

participants.name: Minako

persona.name: Minako
persona.personality: Minako is very calm and acts calmly in any situation. Even when those around her are emotional, she grasps the facts firmly and responds calmly. As a result, she is often asked for her opinion and often takes on a leadership role. She rarely shows her emotions, but she also has a kind side that she shows to those she trusts. She can be a little stubborn and is strong in her convictions. She is also confident in her physical strength and never neglects her training.

participants.private_seed: Nothing funded here runs in isolation, since it lands on shared facilities and services that no single award pays to expand. Given how often that spare capacity has been the thing that gives way, I looked at what state those services are in right now.

participants.name: Servas

persona.name: Servas
persona.personality: Servas has a very calm and composed personality. Based on the knowledge and experience he has gained over the years, he often gives advice to those around him. He is an excellent listener and can talk openly with anyone. He also occasionally expresses deep philosophical thoughts, and his words inspire many people. He is full of vitality and always gives positive energy to those around him.

participants.private_seed: Money can be voted through in an afternoon, while the trained hands a project needs take years to gather and can disappear in a season. That worry sent me to the question of who is genuinely available around here now, and who has already gone.

You are the writer of the discussion described below. You write out the discussion that the participants listed below take part in, under the rules and the flow given.

## Setting
Award of a national grant for basic research in the life sciences. A five-member review panel convened by a national funding agency deliberates over the proposals that reached the final round. One multi-year grant is awarded in this cycle. Participants: Sakura, Takumi, Daisuke, Minako and Servas. Each participant has a concern of their own, which the others do not know.
Things that can be looked into (titles only):
- Travel and bench-fee lines in the ledgers
- National computing agreement and facility day rates
- Incident logs on shared instrumentation
- Station records from partner field sites
- Closeout files of finished awards
- Portfolio review of schedule overruns
- Accreditation and bookings at shared facilities
- National repository deposit turnaround
- Staffing rolls for technical posts
- Minutes on secondments and crew strength

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Servas, Sakura, Daisuke, Takumi and Minako. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.
